findings.claim: In desktop/topic-post.scss, `.topic-meta-data h5 a` has its dark-light-choose arguments swapped. The original light-theme `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` became `dark-light-choose(70%, 30%)` instead of `(30%, 70%)`, so the light-theme link becomes much lighter and lower-contrast.

verifier.reason: In app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss:291, the patch changed `.topic-meta-data h5 a` from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. Because `dark-light-choose` (app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/variables.scss:48-54) returns its first argument for light themes, the lightness percentages are swapped and light-theme links get 70% lightness instead of 30%, making them much lighter and lower-contrast.

findings.claim: In desktop/user.scss and mobile/user.scss, `.group-member-info .name` was converted to `dark-light-choose(50%, 50%)` instead of `(30%, 70%)`. This changes the light-theme lightness from 30% to 50%, the same as `.title`.

verifier.reason: In both app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/user.scss:522 and app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/user.scss:497, `.group-member-info .name` was changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))` instead of `(30%, 70%)`. This inadvertently changes its light-theme lightness from 30% to 50%, matching `.title` directly below (desktop/user.scss:527 and mobile/user.scss:503).

findings.claim: In mobile/topic-post.scss, `.topic-map h3` was converted to `dark-light-choose(50%, 50%)` instead of `(20%, 80%)`. This changes the light-theme lightness from 20% to 50% and diverges from desktop/topic-post.scss, which keeps 20/80.

verifier.reason: In app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss:182, `.topic-map h3` was changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`, altering light-theme lightness from 20% to 50%. By contrast, app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss:321 converts the same 20% value to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))`.

findings.claim: The comment at common/base/discourse.scss:73 still describes the old default `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)`, which is stale after the conversion.
